notes.title: THE WORLD MAILBOX UPDATE
notes.notes: [p]Hello all ːdentonː[/p][p][/p][p]It's been a little while hasn't it ? I’ve been working on life and other projects, but this game still has my heart, so alongside everything else, I’ve been adding in new things, making [i]this[/i] update.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Journal System[/h3][list][*][p]Players can now create as many journal pages as they please.[/p][/*][*][p]Each page can either use a pre-defined prompt (written by Naveen ofc), or choose to title them yourself.[/p][/*][*][p]Each page also lets you pick a mood to reflect how you’re feeling that day.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Design Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Sol got a whole new look! the old one was a bit too thin and didn’t scale well. The new look is softer, warmer, and fits her mother-like persona alot better.[/p][/*][*][p]Neptune now has cool waterfall-like visual effects flowing through its body.[/p][/*][*][p]Jupiter now has her tail! idk why she never had one to begin with.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Character Animations[/h3][list][*][p]Gave all the characters some bone-based animations. Everyone feels more alive and expressive now.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Inventory/Bag[/h3][list][*][p]The inventory is now _always visible_ on the HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a juicy pop-in/out effect when you open/close the bag. Super satisfying.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Colour Customisation System[/h3][list][*][p]Added a system allowing you to change the colours of your collected items.[/p][/*][*][p]This system also works with the letters in the mailbox system (more on that later).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Redesigned the Report Card[/h3][list][*][p]New look + new approach to stat tracking. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Polished some minigames[/h3][p][b]Aphrodite’s Habit Minigame[/b][/p][list][*][p]New sound effects, animations, and icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Habits now have unique icons, helping to visually sort what’s “good” or “bad” in a more interactive way.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Neptune’s Self-Love Minigame[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tried giving it more visual feedback;[/p][/*][*][p]Input box flashes correct/incorrect colours.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a progress indicator - Neptune starts out as a chaotic splash, but slowly takes shape as you make positive progress with your thoughts (symbolism).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Atlas’ Meditation Minigame[/b][/p][list][*][p]Also tried giving it more visual feedback;[/p][/*][*][p]Now there’s a calming Atlas illustration, filling up as you meditate.[/p][/*][*][p]Also added an illustrated breathing guide, showing you how to inhale through the nose, and exhale through the mouth. It's pretty cute.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Spotlight System[/h3][list][*][p]Whenever you interact with something (a character, your inventory, the mailbox), the background now darkens to keep focus on what matters.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Settings Menu[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked the look and layout of settings, tidying everything up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Information Screen[/h3][list][*][p]Slightly improved the look of it too, with a cleaner layout and animated text.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sol's Mood System[/h3][list][*][p]Before venting, Sol now gently asks how you’re feeling.[/p][p][i]You’ll see a bunch of illustrated emotions to choose from, a low-pressure way to express/identify your current emotional status.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]now, last but not least...[/i][/p][h2]THE NEW WORLD MAILBOX SYSTEM !!![/h2][p][i]my favourite things I’ve added.[/i][/p][p][i]a system to ask questions to the strangers of our world, and to read their thoughts.[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Envelopes = Questions, Letters = Answers.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You (the player) can send letters (that you write) to envelopes (that I write). It’s a lil wholesome community-driven system for sharing and connecting with one another.[/p][/*][*][p]I've made the letters customisable using different shapes, colours, and Unity's TextMeshPro tool. Boldness, text colour, size, alignment, opacity etc, make your message truly unique, like you.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Envelopes come with their own unique themes; such as heart-shaped letters for love-related topics, or “note” style letters for "messages to strangers".[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support with my game development journey, i hope you all enjoy what this update has to offer :).[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon in future updates and or in the next project,[/p][p]Malachi[/p]

notes.title: the OVERHAUL update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=P6_ZDmHncfg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]ART & DESIGN OVERHAUL[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] redesigned the pause menu
[*] redesigned aphrodite
[*] added variety to origami paper
[*] added variety to journal covers
[*] added variety to the "Note To Strangers" notes
[/list]

[h3][b]ANIMATION OVERHAUL[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] camera now slightly zooms in to/out of player when pausing
[*] camera pans around based on what the player is looking at
[*] camera now blurs when using the journal, or doing tasks/mini-games
[*] camera now zooms to focus on whoever is speaking
[*] pause menu fades in and out
[*] pause menu containers slightly sway
[*] inventory now slides in and out of view
[*] items within the inventory now slide in and out of view
[*] origami now slightly bounces when folding
[/list]

[h3][b]DIALOGUE SYSTEM OVERHAUL[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] added a speaking style, colour, and sound to every character (including the player),
each setup is made to match the character and personality
[*] cleaned up some of the actual dialogue (grammar, readability, player responses etc)
[/list]
[h3][b]
MUSIC OVERHAUL[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] added a playlist system, music randomly cycles through 3 songs. despite there only being 3 songs, the system will never play the same song twice in a row
[*] (WIP, NOT YET AVAILABLE) added character themes, when speaking to a character, the current track will transition to that characters theme
[/list]

[h3][b]OTHER[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] added more journal prompts
[*] added more note messages
[*] improved note spawn system & altered all spawn locations
[*] fixed some bugs (OOB save corruption, neptune minigame completion acknowledgenent, jupiter minigame restart, aphrodite minigame restart)
[/list]

if you run into any new (or old) bugs, PLEASE let me know, the best place to contact me is in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/gdu7dZk][b]discord server[/b][/url]. hope you all enjoy the update :)
